{"command":"cd /workspace && (
S=outputs/skill/scripts/gen_animation.py; SC=outputs/skill/assets/scaffold.js; R=outputs/fixtures/results
echo '--- T1: 缺少canvas字段 ---'; echo '{"title":"x"}' > $R/bad1.json; python3 $S --config $R/bad1.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad1.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T2: 非法JSON ---'; echo '{title: nope' > $R/bad2.json; python3 $S --config $R/bad2.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad2.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T3: canvas.height为负 ---'; echo '{"title":"x","canvas":{"width":100,"height":-5}}' > $R/bad3.json; python3 $S --config $R/bad3.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad3.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T4: topic缺少TopicSim ---'; echo 'window.nothing = 1;' > $R/bad_topic.js; python3 $S --config outputs/fixtures/skating/config.json --topic $R/bad_topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad4.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- T5: config文件不存在 ---'; python3 $S --config $R/nonexistent.json --topic outputs/fixtures/skating/topic.js --scaffold $SC --out $R/bad5.html; echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- 输出文件检查(应无bad1-5.html) ---'; ls $R/bad1.html $R/bad2.html $R/bad3.html $R/bad4.html $R/bad5.html 2>&1
) > outputs/fixtures/results/badinput_tests.txt 2>&1; cat outputs/fixtures/results/badinput_tests.txt","timeoutSeconds":60,"title":"坏输入测试记录落盘(子shell方式)"}
